do_not_lead_with: Don't open with the Singapore family office seed capital figure or the item requested on 2026-08-12 that was never delivered. Leading with the undelivered item risks sounding like you're covering an internal miss before you've even opened the substantive conversation, and leading with the family office plan skips past the more urgent structural issue — the concentration — which he himself has reason to expect you to raise first. Sales-toned framing of any of these will read poorly given he values direct, evidence-based dialogue.
open_with: Open directly with the concentration position: 24.3% of his wealth sitting in Hong Kong industrials across 2 positions and 2 instrument types. Since he has already flagged this contradiction himself, don't soften it — acknowledge that he's raised it, state the figure plainly, and invite his own analysis of it before offering any view.
